extraction.notes: Net loss, FFO, Core FFO and per-share figures taken from the reconciliation on printed page 9 (seq 12); AFFO from the continued table on printed page 18 (seq 21), which starts from NAREIT FFO (not Core FFO). Core FFO subtotal is labeled 'Core funds from operations' on page 9 and 'Core FFO' elsewhere. The Other non-operating expenses (1) line is advisory and legal services tied to the strategic review and cooperation agreement; no exact fit in the category list, so coded 'other'. Gain on land easements is nil for Q1 2025 (shown as —). Core AFFO of 21,243 (printed page 18) is a further layer beyond AFFO (AFFO + Other non-operating expenses 3,041) and is not captured in this form. The line 'Non-real estate depreciation and amortization of debt costs' combines non-real estate depreciation and debt cost amortization; coded as non_re_depreciation. Allocation to participating securities (89) is not in the FFO-to-Core subtotal chain and was excluded. Diluted shares 88,457 thousand reproduce FFO/share: 18,564/88,457 = 0.21 and 21,605/88,457 = 0.24. Recurring capital improvements are subtracted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. AFFO per share is not reported.
